svg.title: Retries
svg.desc: Top row: the app, the gateway and the message service each try three times while the history database is slow, so one failed tap fans out to 3, then 9, then 27 calls and buries the database. Bottom row: only the message service retries once after a pause, the database sees 2 calls and recovers.
svg.text: Every layer retries, so one tap becomes 27 calls. Retry in one layer only.
